title: MZ A Simple Custom Battle Hud RPG Maker MZ

posts.author: LordLaxy
posts.body:
Hello There. The names Laxy
Ive been making a steam game and I wanted to have battling in this game. I havent used battles before so I didnt really know what I needed to do. Now I am working on the system a bit and I just cant really find a good battle hud. My game only has 1 character you fight with and seeing that all others are made to house 4 they just dont look the greatest. I have the visustella battle core in the game because Im using the grit base game system. But thats besides the point mostly. Im looking for someone that maybe can make a custom layout with the maybe a bit wierd buttons I have in the battle system at the moment. I have quickly sketsched the layout.
The game resolution is 960 x and 720 y. I dont know if you need it but just in case

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: For the command window, maybe if you take the borders off those windows you can just put the actor command window next to the status window. Then change the actor command window width and set the maxCols to return 2. Then for borders you can surround the whole thing with a border element if you want (maybe just a window with borders with nothing drawn inside?).
